registration_limit: All parts and rings were registered to the relevant retained original GeoPDFs. Registered display correspondence does not certify surveyed shores or exact named-water partitions.

complete_feature_observations.independent_observation: Original pixels and complete filled overlays support Misty Lake in the northern head and Lac Brochet in the southern basin of one 61-position ring. The middle corridor and southwest corner remain exact-name-scope gaps. Kingsley Lake lies adjacent west/southwest and is not a proven third component. Coarse margins cross mapped land and omit detailed continuations. Compound scope hold with non-exhaustive associations.

Original pixels and the complete 49-position ring support Kasmere Lake as a bounded generalized identity across the principal basin, northwestern lobe, northeastern head and southern prong. Detailed eastern continuation and southwestern outlet extend outside the ring; mapped land, bays and narrow peninsulas are simplified. Nearby Tice, Koona and Snyder labels do not establish additional selected components. No exact extent or scalar product clearance.

Both original maps and full 20-position overlays show the selected triangular footprint in a western branched water lobe. Bannock Lake is labelled on the separate eastern narrow water, outside the ring. The target includes land between inlets and omits large continuations. No direct selected-water name is established; Bannock, Kingston, Watson or Wollaston cannot be transferred to this ring by proximity or apparent connectivity. Unresolved identity/extent hold; sources are usable.

source_group_limit: Three reviewed official publications; only one provides established selected-water naming associations. Hydrographic dataset independence is unverified, and no formal naming registry was checked.
